translations.literal: Our followers in the north number nearly ten thousand households; Mengxun is now recruiting and cherishing the people—preserve life and continue the line—you should go to him;
translations.idiomatic: Our followers in the north number nearly ten thousand households; Mengxun is now winning over the people and restoring broken lines—you should go to him;

sentences.zh: 匕勃、洛肱亦與尼俱行。

translations.literal: Hebo and Luogong should also go with Fani.
translations.idiomatic: Hebo and Luogong should go with Fani as well.

sentences.zh: 吾年老矣，所適不容，寧見妻子而死！」

translations.literal: I am old; no place will take me in—I would rather see my wife and children and die!"
translations.idiomatic: I am old; nowhere will have me—I would rather see my wife and children and die!"

sentences.zh: 遂歸於熾磐，唯陰利鹿隨之。

translations.literal: He then went over to Chibpan; only Yin Lilu followed him.
translations.idiomatic: He then surrendered to Chibpan; only Yin Lilu followed him.

sentences.zh: 辱檀謂利鹿曰：「吾親屬皆散，卿何獨留？」

translations.literal: Rutan said to Lilu, "My kinsmen have all dispersed—why do you alone remain?"
translations.idiomatic: Rutan said to Lilu, "My relatives have all gone—why do you alone stay?"

sentences.zh: 利鹿曰：「臣老母在家，非不思歸；

translations.literal: Lilu said, "My old mother is at home—it is not that I do not wish to return;
translations.idiomatic: Lilu said, "My old mother is at home—it is not that I do not long to return;

sentences.zh: 然委質為臣，忠孝之道，難以兩全。

translations.literal: Yet having pledged myself as your minister, the way of loyalty and filial piety cannot both be fully fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: But having pledged myself as your minister, loyalty and filial piety cannot both be fully kept.

sentences.zh: 臣不才，不難為陛下泣血求救於鄰國，敢離左右乎！」

translations.literal: Though I lack talent, I would not shrink from weeping blood and begging rescue from a neighboring state for Your Majesty—how could I dare leave your side!"
translations.idiomatic: Though I am without talent, I would not hesitate to weep blood and beg neighboring states for Your Majesty's rescue—how could I leave your side!"

sentences.zh: 人辱檀歎曰：「知人固未易。

translations.literal: Rutan sighed and said, "To know people is indeed not easy.
translations.idiomatic: Rutan sighed and said, "Knowing people is truly not easy.

sentences.zh: 大臣親戚皆棄我去，今日忠義終始不虧者，唯卿一人而已！」

translations.literal: Ministers and kinsmen have all abandoned me; today the one whose loyalty and righteousness never wavered from first to last is you alone!"
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and relatives have all left me; today the one whose loyalty never failed from start to finish is you alone!"

sentences.zh: 辱檀諸城皆降於熾磐，獨尉賢政屯浩宜，固守不下。

translations.literal: All of Rutan's cities submitted to Chibpan; only Commandant Wei Xianzheng held Haoyi and refused to yield.
translations.idiomatic: All of Rutan's cities surrendered to Chibpan; only Commandant Wei Xianzheng held Haoyi and would not submit.

sentences.zh: 熾磐遣人謂之曰：「樂都已潰，卿妻子皆在吾所，獨守一城，將何為也？」

translations.literal: Chibpan sent someone to tell him, "Ledu has already fallen; your wife and children are in my hands—guarding one city alone, what do you mean to do?"
translations.idiomatic: Chibpan sent someone to tell him, "Ledu has already fallen; your wife and children are in my hands—holding one city alone, what do you hope to accomplish?"

sentences.zh: 賢政曰：「受涼王厚恩，為國籓屏。

translations.literal: Xianzheng said, "I received great favor from the Liang king and serve as a bulwark of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzheng said, "I received great kindness from the Liang king and serve as a shield of the realm.

sentences.zh: 雖知樂都已陷，妻子為禽；

translations.literal: Though I know Ledu has fallen and my wife and children are captured;
translations.idiomatic: Though I know Ledu has fallen and my wife and children are prisoners;

sentences.zh: 先歸獲賞，後順受誅。

translations.literal: Those who submit first win reward, those who submit later face execution.
translations.idiomatic: Those who surrender first are rewarded; those who surrender later are punished.

sentences.zh: 然不知主上存亡，未敢歸命；

translations.literal: Yet I do not know whether my lord lives or dies, and dare not surrender;
translations.idiomatic: But I do not know whether my lord lives or dies, and dare not submit;

sentences.zh: 妻子小事，豈足動心！

translations.literal: Wife and children are a small matter—how could they sway my heart!
translations.idiomatic: Wife and children are a small matter—how could they move my heart!

sentences.zh: 若貪一時之利，忘委付之重者，大王亦安用之！」

translations.literal: If one greedily seeks a moment's gain and forgets the weight of what was entrusted, how could Your Highness employ such a man!"
translations.idiomatic: If I grasped a moment's gain and forgot the weight of what was entrusted to me, how could Your Highness use such a man!"

sentences.zh: 熾磐乃遣虎台以手書諭之，賢政曰：「汝為儲副，不能盡節，面縛於人，棄父忘君，墮萬世之業。

translations.literal: Chibpan then sent Hutai with a letter in his own hand to instruct him; Xianzheng said, "You are the heir—unable to give your utmost loyalty, bound before others, abandoning your father and forgetting your lord, throwing away the enterprise of ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Chibpan then sent Hutai with a letter in his own hand to instruct him; Xianzheng said, "You are the heir apparent, yet you could not give your full loyalty, bound yourself before others, abandoned your father and forgot your lord, and ruined the enterprise of ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 賢政義士，豈效汝乎！」

translations.literal: A man of righteousness like Xianzheng—would he imitate you!"
translations.idiomatic: A righteous man like Xianzheng—would he follow your example!"

sentences.zh: 聞辱檀至左南，乃降。

translations.literal: When he heard Rutan had reached Zuonan, he surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard Rutan had reached Zuonan, he submitted.

sentences.zh: 熾磐聞辱檀至，遣使郊迎，待以上賓之禮。

translations.literal: When Chibpan heard Rutan had arrived, he sent envoys to meet him outside the city and treated him with the honors due a chief guest.
translations.idiomatic: When Chibpan heard Rutan had arrived, he sent envoys to welcome him outside the city and treated him as a chief guest.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，熾磐以辱檀為驃騎大將軍，賜爵左南公。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Chibpan made Rutan General of Agile Cavalry and enfeoffed him as Duke of Zuonan.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Chibpan made Rutan General of Agile Cavalry and enfeoffed him as Duke of Zuonan.

sentences.zh: 南涼文武，依才銓敘。

translations.literal: Southern Liang civil and military officials were ranked according to talent.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Liang civil and military officials were ranked according to their abilities.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，熾磐使人鴆辱檀；

translations.literal: After more than a year, Chibpan had someone poison Rutan;
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year, Chibpan had Rutan poisoned;

sentences.zh: 左右請解之，辱檀曰：「吾病豈宜療邪！」

translations.literal: His attendants asked to treat him; Rutan said, "My illness—is it fit to cure!"
translations.idiomatic: His attendants asked to treat him; Rutan said, "This illness of mine—is it fit to cure!"

sentences.zh: 遂死，謚曰景王。

translations.literal: He died; posthumous title King Jing.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was given the posthumous title King Jing.

sentences.zh: 虎台亦為熾磐所殺。

translations.literal: Hutai was also killed by Chibpan.
translations.idiomatic: Hutai was also killed by Chibpan.

sentences.zh: 辱檀子保周、賀，俱延子覆龍，利鹿孤孫副周，烏孤孫承缽，皆奔河西王蒙遜；

translations.literal: Rutan's sons Baozhou and He, Juyan's son Fulong, Lilugu's grandson Fuzhou, and Wugu's grandson Chengba—all fled to Hexi King Mengxun;
translations.idiomatic: Rutan's sons Baozhou and He, Juyan's son Fulong, Lilugu's grandson Fuzhou, and Wugu's grandson Chengba all fled to Hexi King Mengxun;

sentences.zh: 久之，又奔魏。

translations.literal: After a long time they fled again to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time they fled to Wei as well.

sentences.zh: 魏以保周為張掖王，覆龍為酒泉公，賀西平公，副周永平公，承缽昌松公。

translations.literal: Wei made Baozhou King of Zhangye, Fulong Duke of Jiuquan, He Duke of Xiping, Fuzhou Duke of Yongping, and Chengba Duke of Changsong.
translations.idiomatic: Wei made Baozhou King of Zhangye, Fulong Duke of Jiuquan, He Duke of Xiping, Fuzhou Duke of Yongping, and Chengba Duke of Changsong.

sentences.zh: 魏主嗣愛賀之才，謂曰：「卿之先與朕同源。」

translations.literal: Emperor Si of Wei admired He's talent and said, "Your ancestors and I share the same origin."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Si of Wei admired He's talent and said, "Your ancestors and I share the same origin."

sentences.zh: 賜姓源氏。

translations.literal: He was given the surname Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the surname Yuan.

sentences.zh: 八月，戊子，魏主嗣遣馬邑侯陋孫使於秦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuzi, Emperor Si of Wei sent Marquis of Mayi Sun Lousun as envoy to Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuzi, Emperor Si of Wei sent Marquis of Mayi Sun Lousun as envoy to Qin.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣謁者於什門使於燕，悅力延使於柔然。

translations.literal: On xinchou, he sent Gentleman Yu Shimen as envoy to Yan and Yue Liyan as envoy to Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, he sent Gentleman Yu Shimen as envoy to Yan and Yue Liyan as envoy to Rouran.

sentences.zh: 於什門至和龍，不肯入見，曰：「大魏皇帝有詔，須馮王出受，然後敢入。」

translations.literal: Yu Shimen reached Helong and refused to enter and be received, saying, "The Great Wei emperor has an edict—it requires Prince Feng to come out to receive it before I dare enter."
translations.idiomatic: Yu Shimen reached Helong and refused to enter for an audience, saying, "The Great Wei emperor has an edict; Prince Feng must come out to receive it before I dare enter."

sentences.zh: 燕王跋使人牽逼令入，什門見跋不拜。

translations.literal: King Ba of Yan had men drag and force him to enter; Shimen saw Ba but did not bow.
translations.idiomatic: King Ba of Yan had men drag him in by force; Shimen saw Ba but would not bow.

sentences.zh: 跋使人按其項，什門曰：「馮王拜受詔，吾自以賓主致敬，何若見逼邪！」

translations.literal: Ba had men press down on his neck; Shimen said, "When Prince Feng bows to receive the edict, I myself pay respect as host and guest—why must I be forced!"
translations.idiomatic: Ba had men press down on his neck; Shimen said, "When Prince Feng bows to receive the edict, I pay respect as between host and guest—why must I be forced!"

sentences.zh: 跋怒，留什門不遣，什門數眾辱之。

translations.literal: Ba was angry, detained Shimen and would not release him; Shimen repeatedly publicly humiliated him.
translations.idiomatic: Ba was angry, kept Shimen and would not release him; Shimen repeatedly humiliated him before the crowd.

sentences.zh: 左右請殺之，跋曰：「彼各為其主耳。」

translations.literal: His attendants asked to kill him; Ba said, "Each serves his own lord."
translations.idiomatic: His attendants asked to kill him; Ba said, "Each serves his own lord."

sentences.zh: 乃幽執什門，欲降之，什門終不降。

translations.literal: He then imprisoned Shimen, wishing to win him over, but Shimen never submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He then imprisoned Shimen, hoping to win him over, but Shimen never yielded.

sentences.zh: 久之，衣冠弊壞略盡，蟣虱流溢。

translations.literal: After a long time his clothes and hat were nearly all worn out and lice overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time his clothes were nearly in rags and lice swarmed over him.

sentences.zh: 跋遺之衣冠，什門皆不受。

translations.literal: Ba sent him clothes and a hat; Shimen would accept none of them.
translations.idiomatic: Ba sent him clothes and a hat; Shimen refused them all.

sentences.zh: 魏主嗣以博士王諒為平南參軍，使以平南將軍、相州刺史尉太真書與太尉裕相聞。

translations.literal: Emperor Si of Wei appointed Academician Wang Liang as aide to the Pacifier of the South and had him carry a letter from General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou Wei Taizhen to greet Grand Commandant Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Si of Wei appointed Academician Wang Liang as aide to the Pacifier of the South and had him carry a letter from General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou Wei Taizhen to greet Grand Commandant Yu.

sentences.zh: 豐真，古真之弟也。

translations.literal: Fengzhen was Guzhen's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Fengzhen was Guzhen's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 九月，丁已朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day dingsi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the first day dingsi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，河南王熾磐復稱秦王，置百官。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Henan King Chibpan again styled himself King of Qin and established the full bureaucracy.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, Henan King Chibpan again styled himself King of Qin and established the full bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 燕主跋與夏連和，夏王勃勃遣御史中丞烏洛孤如燕蒞盟。

translations.literal: King Ba of Yan allied with Xia; Xia King Bobo sent Supervising Secretary Wuluogu to Yan to preside over the alliance.
translations.idiomatic: King Ba of Yan allied with Xia; Xia King Bobo sent Supervising Secretary Wuluogu to Yan to oversee the alliance.

sentences.zh: 十一月，壬午，魏主嗣遣使者巡行諸州，校閱守宰資財，非家所繼者，悉薄為贓。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renwu, Emperor Si of Wei sent envoys to tour the provinces, examine the assets of prefects and magistrates, and classify as stolen goods anything not inherited from family.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renwu, Emperor Si of Wei sent envoys to tour the provinces, review the assets of prefects and magistrates, and treat as stolen goods anything not inherited from their families.

sentences.zh: 西秦王熾磐立妃禿髮氏為後。

translations.literal: Western Qin King Chibpan installed his consort the Tufa lady as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Western Qin King Chibpan made his consort of the Tufa clan empress.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丙戌朔，柔然可汗大檀侵魏。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day bingxu, Rouran Khagan Datan invaded Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the first day bingxu, Rouran Khagan Datan invaded Wei.

sentences.zh: 丙申，魏主嗣北擊之。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Emperor Si of Wei struck north against him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Emperor Si of Wei marched north to attack him.

sentences.zh: 大檀走，遣奚斤等追之，遇大雪，士卒凍死及墮指者什二三。

translations.literal: Datan fled; he sent Xi Jin and others in pursuit; they met heavy snow and two or three tenths of the soldiers froze to death or lost fingers to frostbite.
translations.idiomatic: Datan fled; he sent Xi Jin and others in pursuit; they met heavy snow, and two or three tenths of the soldiers froze to death or lost fingers to frostbite.

sentences.zh: 河內人司馬順宰自稱晉王，魏人討之，不克。

translations.literal: Sima Shunzai of Henei styled himself King of Jin; Wei forces attacked but could not overcome him.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Shunzai of Henei styled himself King of Jin; Wei forces attacked him but could not defeat him.

sentences.zh: 燕遼西公素弗卒，燕王跋比葬七臨之。

translations.literal: Duke of Liaoxi Sufu of Yan died; King Ba of Yan attended the funeral seven times in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Liaoxi Sufu of Yan died; King Ba of Yan visited the burial seven times in succession.

sentences.zh: 是歲，司馬國璠兄弟聚眾數百，潛渡淮，夜入廣陵城。

translations.literal: That year, Sima Guofan and his brothers gathered several hundred men, secretly crossed the Huai, and entered Guangling city by night.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Sima Guofan and his brothers gathered several hundred men, secretly crossed the Huai, and entered Guangling by night.

sentences.zh: 青州刺史檀祗領廣陵相，國璠兵直上聽事，祗驚出，將御之，被射傷而入，謂左右曰：「賊乘暗得入，欲掩我不備；

translations.literal: Inspector of Qingzhou Tan Qi was also prefect of Guangling; Guofan's men went straight up to the hall of audience; Qi startled out, was about to resist, was shot and wounded and went back in, and said to his attendants, "The bandits entered in the dark seeking to catch me unawares;
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Qingzhou Tan Qi was also prefect of Guangling; Guofan's men went straight to the hall of audience; Qi rushed out to meet them, was shot and wounded as he tried to resist, went back inside, and said to his attendants, "The bandits entered in the dark to catch me off guard;

sentences.zh: 但擊五鼓，彼懼曉，必走矣。」

translations.literal: Just strike the fifth watch drum—they will fear dawn and surely flee."
translations.idiomatic: Just strike the fifth watch drum—they will fear dawn and surely flee."

sentences.zh: 左右如其言，國璠兵果走，追殺百餘人。

translations.literal: His attendants did as he said; Guofan's men indeed fled; they pursued and killed more than a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: His attendants did as he said; Guofan's men indeed fled, and they pursued and killed more than a hundred.

sentences.zh: 魏博士祭灑崔浩為魏主嗣講《易》及《洪範》，嗣因問浩天文、術數。

translations.literal: Wei Academician Who Performs Sacrifices Cui Hao lectured Emperor Si on the Changes and the Great Plan; Si then questioned Hao on astronomy and numerical arts.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Academician Who Performs Sacrifices Cui Hao lectured Emperor Si on the Book of Changes and the Great Plan; Si then questioned Hao about astronomy and divination.

sentences.zh: 浩占決多驗，由是有寵，凡軍國密謀皆預之。

translations.literal: Hao's divinations and decisions mostly proved accurate; from this he gained favor, and all secret military and state plans he participated in.
translations.idiomatic: Hao's divinations mostly proved accurate; from this he gained favor, and he took part in all secret military and state plans.

sentences.zh: 夏王勃勃立夫人梁氏為王后，子瑰為太子；

translations.literal: Xia King Bobo installed his wife Lady Liang as queen and his son Gui as crown prince;
translations.idiomatic: Xia King Bobo made his wife Lady Liang queen and his son Gui crown prince;

sentences.zh: 封子延為陽平公，昌為太原公，倫為酒泉公，定為平原公，滿為河南公，安為中山公。

translations.literal: He enfeoffed his sons: Yan as Duke of Yangping, Chang as Duke of Taiyuan, Lun as Duke of Jiuquan, Ding as Duke of Pingyuan, Man as Duke of Henan, and An as Duke of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: He enfeoffed his sons Yan as Duke of Yangping, Chang as Duke of Taiyuan, Lun as Duke of Jiuquan, Ding as Duke of Pingyuan, Man as Duke of Henan, and An as Duke of Zhongshan.
